title: Custom-field list query is not validated: pageSize uncapped and isActive string breaks filter
test_evidence: Failing-first at 4c7fb8fe: 3 new PRC-L447 tests fail (isActive=true returned [] ; pageSize=101 and pageSize=0 returned 200). After fix: pnpm --filter @proctira/backend-custom-field test 5 files 81/81 pass; typecheck exit 0; eslint 0 errors; prettier clean.

title: Definition update can strip dropdown options / rules, and date validator accepts impossible dates

Commit 260ee433.
